name: Vegetarian Lentil Eggplant Moussaka

components.name: Lentil Eggplant Moussaka
steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Slice eggplant and potatoes thinly, brush with measured oil and roast in single layers 20-25 minutes until just tender.
Rinse dry lentils and simmer in measured water until tender, 25-35 minutes, then drain if needed.
Soften onions and garlic in 25 ml oil, cook tomatoes and cinnamon/oregano, then fold in cooked lentils to make thick sauce.
Make bechamel by melting butter, whisking in flour and slowly adding milk until smooth and thick; cool slightly before whisking in egg and vegetarian hard cheese.
Layer potatoes, eggplant and lentil sauce in a deep baking dish, then spread bechamel over the top.
Bake at 185 C for 40-50 minutes until golden and centre is set; rest 20 minutes before slicing into six. This is an extended multi-stage recipe.
